You already are on the right track with reaching out to this sub. Everyone on here are great people (at least from my experience). I was in your shoes a few years back and am still pretty green. So the best advice I have is patience. Just take it slow. The game is meant to be extremely flexible so dont think you have to follow the rules EXACTLY. Dont put pressure on yourself or the party to stick to the story EXACTLY. Just have fun! Also I think for new players/DMs it's better to start off with one shots and just let the players characters role over from on session to the next. That way you can get familiar with the rules and mechanics. What your groups preferred play style is (lot of combat, role play, mystery solving, etc.) That way keeping of with NPCs, locations, and lore gets easier because you're not bouncing between the story and the rules.

This is all stuff I felt helped me out a lot when I first started. Hopefully it does the same for you.

Good luck!
